description: Screenshot any public web page. Returns a JPEG (base64 data URL plus a hosted URL). Options: width (320-2560, default 1280), height (300-8000, default 900), fullPage (boolean). Takes 3-15 s. Price: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Without payment, returns the payment requirements.

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.

name: screenshot
title: Screenshot any public web page
